title: China killed Claude Fable 5. Moonshot AI just quietly dropped Kimi K3
description:
Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's latest open-source flagship model, built for coding, AI agents, long-context reasoning, and complex multi-step workflows.

With a massive 1 million token context window and support for multi-agent collaboration, it's designed to tackle entire codebases, deep research, and large-scale development tasks that would overwhelm most AI models.

If you're looking for a powerful open-source alternative for coding and agent workflows, Kimi K3 is one of the biggest releases of the year.

#kimi #opensource #ai #aiagents #coding
